title_zh: 选定有舞台改编的共读小说并限制剧透

scenario.label_zh: 选择有改编版本的小说并限定讨论章节
scenario.goal_zh: 确认小说的暴力呈现方式，选定共读并约定先讨论开头而不透露结局

context_zh: 读书会组织者选择下一本作品，书名与内容均为虚构。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Suki
sentences.text: Would The Glass Harbour work for our next meeting? I liked the stage adaptation.

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: Possibly. Is there much violence in the novel? Some members asked us to avoid graphic descriptions.

sentences.speaker: Suki
sentences.text: The attack happens off the page. We hear about its effects later, but there's no detailed description of it.

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: Good. I want to watch the mystery unfold without knowing who did it.

sentences.speaker: Suki
sentences.text: Then let's keep the ending unknown until everyone has finished. At the first meeting, we can discuss only the opening chapters.

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: That works for me. Let's choose it and put the chapter limit in the invitation.
